stages.title: Inspect requirements and current behavior
stages.prompt: Read the authoritative inputs and repository guidance. Identify conflicts, constraints, affected files, and verification commands.
verification: Relevant files and constraints are recorded
Material conflicts are resolved or blocked

stages.title: Implement the scoped change
stages.prompt: Implement only the agreed scope while preserving unrelated work and existing contracts.
verification: Changed code matches the scoped outcome

stages.title: Verify the primary change
stages.prompt: Run targeted and repository-level checks required by the task. Diagnose failures and distinguish new failures from evidenced pre-existing failures.
verification: Required broader checks pass or are documented

stages.title: Audit and fix mechanical findings
stages.prompt: Audit the completed change. Fix only cheap mechanical findings and record substantive findings for review.
